fixture: pnpm e2e:serve --save-action with MNEMON_CLI_PATH. Only the task Agent decisions are scripted; the dialog, Host tools and Native writes are real.
procedure: Send one message; the reply is the fixture release checklist.
Save to memory: cut the candidate to its first sentence and send it.
Edit the answered candidate and send it again.
Read the Native store with mnemon --readonly recall --basic.
